answer: Vest new agents' rewards like seasoning timber: a fresh key's first 40 epochs of earnings sit locked and release 2.5% per epoch. If peers later prove the key belongs to a sybil swarm, the unvested delta is burnt. A farmer spinning up a nebula of 500 keys must wait 40 hours per key with all of it at risk, so a single exposure wipes out the whole batch, while one honest agent loses nothing by waiting.
